name: Jilin Aodong Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jilin Aodong Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in China. It provides various drugs, such as oral liquid solutions, injections, capsules, granules, pills, tablets, Chinese herbal medicines, powders, tonic medicines, syrups, and spirits, as well as enzymes, biochemical medicine, and plant chemical medicine.
